thread:
Taylor: quick design review: the p95 clip handle overlaps the mini-sampler on compact cards. on narrow widths the sampler pushes the p95 badge partially off-screen and mobile taps miss the control.
Rae: saw this in staging. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder/latency-mini-card. screenshot attached.
Jun: proposal: move sampler into the legend area (right side) instead of floating over the chart. keeps chart stable and avoids overlay intercept. add a small "sampled 10%" chip next to the legend so density is honest.
Marta: microcopy: change default label from "Sampling" to "Sampling: Adaptive". tooltip full string: "Adaptive 12 balances latency and quality" (short: "Adaptive"). for aggressive mode: "Aggressive 12 lower fidelity, lower cost". keep translations in mind.
Taylor: accessibility: aria-label should read "Sampling mode, Adaptive"; toggles should be operable with space/enter and announce mode changes via live region. focus ring must meet 3:1 contrast.
Jun: dev note: use invisible 44px hit area (centered) to keep visuals compact. CSS sketch: `.sampler{width:24px;height:24px;position:relative}.sampler::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;top:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;}`
Rae: UX nit: when sampling <100% consider a subtle pattern overlay on unsampled buckets in the heatmap legend preview so users don't assume full fidelity.
Marta: I'll draft copy variants and length guidelines for i18n by EOD.
Jun: I'll prototype the hit target, aria labels, and keyboard announce PR. include e2e for focus.
Rae: I'll update Figma with the legend placement and the sampled-chip, and do a contrast pass for dark/light.
DesignBot: calendar invite created for 2026-04-01 10:00 PT for visual sign-off.
Taylor: thanks all 12 closing; reopen if blockers
_meta: Slack thread: debate about p95 clip overlap, sampler placement, sampled legend chip, copy tweaks, hit targets, and keyboard accessibility for latency/throughput observability UI.
